category.name: PDF editing and processing
category.description: Tools to edit PDF content or organize, split, merge, convert and process PDF documents.
category.audience: People handling forms, reports, scans and other PDF documents at home, school and work.
category.audienceRationale: PDF work spans many roles and personal document tasks; editing and page processing are distinct needs.

oss.name: Stirling PDF
locked: Login-capable Free server limited to five users; Team adds capacity.
External database, clustering, S3/database file storage, metrics and custom metadata require Team.
SAML, audit logs and offline license activation require Enterprise.
oss.classificationReason: Mixed-license project. Pinned root grants MIT only outside eight excluded directories, including engine, proprietary editor, desktop, SaaS/cloud and processor. Restrictive User License observed for engine/editor modules. A complete operational build from only MIT code was not established; full distribution is not certified OSI and excluded from default recommendations. Paid admin gates are documented separately from processing service costs.
serviceLimitations: Processor/AI automation and API-key calls can draw on processing allowances; these are separate from software admin gates.

oss.name: PDFsam Basic
oss.classificationReason: The named Basic desktop edition runs locally without watermarks or file-size limits; all six Basic tools are free. Enhanced and Visual are distinct commercial products, not extra Basic OSS modules. Basic handles page manipulation rather than full text editing, OCR or conversion.
serviceLimitations: Local desktop app, not a hosted web service or self-hosted server.

oss.name: PDF Arranger
oss.classificationReason: GPL desktop source application with page split/merge, rotate, crop and rearrange functions; source installation and binary downloads documented. No commercial edition or paid gate found in the official product README. Scope is page arrangement, not full PDF content editing.
serviceLimitations: Local GTK desktop app; no vendor hosted service documented.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Use existing PDF files locally for split, merge, rotate, mix and page extraction. Basic does not replace Acrobat text editing, OCR, conversion, forms or e-signature collection.

Local page-processing replacement for Smallpdf merge, split, rotate and extract tasks. No cloud account migration; retain PDF files. Basic lacks Smallpdf OCR, content editing and compression workflows.
Open PDF files locally for page split, merge, rotate, crop and rearrangement. Does not replace the wider conversion, text editing, signing or cloud-sharing service.

exclusions.name: PDFsam Enhanced

exclusions.name: PDFsam Visual
exclusions.reason: Separate commercial product; page organization/compression and many other tools require subscription or perpetual license; free tools do not make the complete product OSS.
